assumptions.rule: Band month M uses monthly INDEC IPC M-2
assumptions.calculation: Calendar-day compound factors (1+IPC/100)^(1/days in month) for upper, (1-IPC/100)^(1/days in month) for lower
assumptions.missing_monthly_REM: Use implied flat monthly rate from REM 12-month YoY; not an official individual monthly forecast
assumptions.hypothetical_older_scenarios: Original dashboard scenario is a sensitivity only, not REM official
assumptions.comparison_warning: REM nominal FX is a monthly average; the band ceiling is a value at date/month-end
